_template.scope: Schema/path skeleton only; no result, efficacy disposition, budget reset or authorization is recorded.
completion_instructions: Root must write a separate final manifest after collecting actual completed evidence; do not execute this template.
Fill each FileRef sha256 from that exact unchanged file. Native source hash values are also null and must come from the applicable frozen execution/source lock.
Confirm future analysis output paths against actual analyzer command receipts; the listed future filenames are path hints, not claims that files exist.
Set each calibration/native required_status only from the actual successful producer result after auditing the child wrapper/session-drain evidence.

Resolve both B entries to the actual selected U/F16/P4/F8/P512 arm and its exact common-domain control file. Selection uses two independent common-domain run medians with frozen tie order; no capacity result enters this pool.
Arm label P4 means the four-unit pressure candidate, not authorization for implementation stage P4.
For each capacity domain use only its v2 loaded-U plan with the original full128 reference. Do not use its one-token cost reference for a model cohort.
Set capacity disposition from real original-threshold numeric/cost gate evidence: PASS, FAILED_NUMERIC_GATE, or FAILED_COST_GATE. Resource-blocked/unattempted phases remain incomplete.
If numeric qualification really fails, retain the two executed reference phases only. If cost qualification really fails, retain all six phases and the genuine failed cost result.
Keep exactly one loaded-U sensitivity per passed capacity and none for a genuinely pruned capacity; future placeholders in capacity_runs must be removed only on that proven branch.

Typed selector equals values below are prospective audit predicates, not recorded observations. Build new normalized lineage/delivery receipts only from actual source-bound evidence; do not fill a successful predicate from a plan alone.
Lineage receipts must disclose finite candidate/source/gate disposition per all six dimensions and do not imply a Cartesian or global-optimum search.

Final delivery receipt must retain original lock/source/version paths and SHAs, actual idle GPU ledger, storage/source preservation, final problem report and exact reproduction commands. It must not infer budget renewal or GPU permission.
After final-manifest assembly, root runs the locked analyzer on CPU; missing fields/paths/null SHA remain INCOMPLETE.
Engineering evidence completeness is separate from efficacy and final P3 closure. P4 is never enabled by this template or analyzer.
